_meta: Per-species anatomy checklist for ref_critic.py. Each item must be visibly TRUE in the reference image. 'pose' = rules for a shape-friendly reference (Hunyuan3D input). Add species as needed; '_default' applies to every species.
_default: exactly one creature, whole body in frame, nothing cropped
plain white or transparent background, no ground plane, no shadow, no pedestal, no text
limbs, tail and head are separated from the body silhouette (no limb hidden behind another along the full length)
no extra or missing body parts, no merged or duplicated limbs
wolf: exactly 4 legs, each ending in a paw on the ground line
standing pose, legs roughly straight, side or 3/4 side view
canine proportions: deep chest, narrow waist, long legs
horse: exactly 4 long legs ending in hooves
standing square, side or 3/4 side view
roach: insect (cockroach), NOT a bee, beetle-with-wings-spread, ant or spider
exactly 6 jointed legs, 3 per side, attached to the thorax
broad flat shield-like pronotum covering the head from above
2 long thin antennae, at least body length
flat oval body, wings folded flat over the abdomen (not spread, not translucent bee wings)
2 short cerci at the rear tip of the abdomen
no stinger, no stripes of a bee/wasp, no fur
giraffe: very long neck, about leg length
back slopes straight down from withers to rump, no hump
crocodile: low body close to the ground line
frog: exactly 4 legs: 2 short front, 2 long folded hind
2 bulging eyes on top of the head
tortoise: head and neck extended out of the shell
